Dr. '''Kedar Lal Shrestha''' (Nepali: केदारलाल श्रेष्ठ) was a physicist and academic from Nepal. He was born on 23 October 1938 in [[Lalitpur, Nepal]].<ref>{{cite book |title=An encounter with Kedar Lal Shrestha |date=2018 |publisher=Symmetry |pages=34–41 |edition=12 |url=https://tucdp.edu.np/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/SymmetryXII_LowResolution.pdf}}</ref> He served various governmental and non-governmental agencies including policy making of Kathmandu Metropolitan. He died in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web| title = रहनुभएन भौतिकशास्त्री–वैज्ञानिक डा. केदारलाल श्रेष्ठ| work = ekagaj| accessdate = 2021-01-17| url = https://ekagaj.com/article/thought/1814?v=1}}</ref>

==Biography==
Shrestha was born as a single child of father Ratna Lal Shrestha and mother Hari Devi Shrestha. He did his schooling from Patan High School. He completed ISc from [[Trichandra College]] and MSc from [[Allahabad University]] in 1960 with physics as a major.<ref name="rs21">{{Cite web| title = सालिन भौतिकशास्त्री डा. केदारलाल श्रेष्ठ| accessdate = 2021-01-17| date = 2015-01-05| url = https://revoscience.com/np/2015/01/05/286}}</ref> He received a PhD from [[Queensland University]] in 1967.{{cn|date=May 2024}}

After PhD, he started as a professor in physics in [[Tribhuwan University]]. He worked as department head from 1971 to 1986. From 1979 to 1986, he worked for RECAST.<ref name="kp20"/> He also worked as vice president in [[Nepal Academy of Science and Technology]] from 1992 to 1997.<ref>{{Cite web| title = केदारलाल श्रेष्ठ Archives - Nepalpatra Nepalpatra| work = Nepalpatra| accessdate = 2021-01-17| url = https://nepalpatra.com/tag/%E0%A4%95%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%A6%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B0%E0%A4%B2%E0%A4%BE%E0%A4%B2-%E0%A4%B6%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%B0%E0%A5%87%E0%A4%B7%E0%A5%8D%E0%A4%A0/}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web| title = ध्वस्त पार्‍यौं काठमाडौं, अब सम्हालौं| work = Setopati| accessdate = 2021-01-17| url = https://www.setopati.com/politics/116201/}}</ref>

He has two sons and two daughters.<ref>{{Cite web| title = रहेनन् ललितपुर महानगर सल्लाहकार शिक्षाविद् केदारलाल श्रेष्ठ| work = News of Nepal| accessdate = 2021-01-17| url = https://www.newsofnepal.com/2020/11/26/365536/}}</ref>

He died in 2020 at the age of 82 in Kathmandu.<ref name="kp20">{{Cite web| title = नास्टका पूर्वउपकुलपति केदारलाल श्रेष्ठको निधन| accessdate = 2021-01-17| url = https://ekantipur.com/news/2020/11/26/160638138698528231.html}}</ref>
